_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "tone" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "products" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "detail" TEXT NULL, "base_price" INTEGER NOT NULL, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "product_variants" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "price" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "addons" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "price" INTEGER NOT NULL, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "product_addons" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id), "addon_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES addons (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sales" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "subtotal" INTEGER NOT NULL, "total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "cashier_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "voided_at" INTEGER NULL, "voided_by" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("device_id", "number"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sale_lines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sale_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sales (id), "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id), "variant_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES product_variants (id), "product_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "variant_name" TEXT NULL, "quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unit_price" INTEGER NOT NULL, "line_total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "addons" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "payments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sale_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sales (id), "method" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tendered" INTEGER NULL, "change_given" INTEGER NULL, "momo_reference" TEXT NULL, "customer" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stock_movements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id), "variant_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES product_variants (id), "quantity_change" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL, "sale_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES sales (id), "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "outbox" ("seq" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "record_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "operation" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meta" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
